provenance: Independently authored by an independent test-case author after reviewing frozen adapter commit e069354aa286c09e8a9c45c207bee5de8dcf2f72. Inputs and handwritten expected answers were derived from the unchanged PRD and fictional catalog, without model outputs or any local model call. The owner/implementer remained blind to this new fixture before actual evaluation. The author had reviewed the frozen adapter and the previously exposed holdout, 808472c, a12decc, 168eee7 and 52ad168 suites (only to avoid duplicating them); this is not claimed to be an implementation-blind author. Expectations were fixed before any actual inference and checked offline against catalog arithmetic.
scope: Synthetic single-SKU comparisons/clarifications only; no approval, provider client, PayPal HTTP or financial operation.
answer_rules: canonical_constraints contains supported values only. Do not send AUD or one_time=false to canonical Constraints or invent their USD/one-time replacements.

For the AUD case reject the explicit unsupported intent. The Australian-dollar amount stays in raw_unsupported_intent; a proposed future revision needs both USD currency agreement and a separately supplied USD budget.
For weekly delivery reject the explicit unsupported intent. A proposed future revision needs human agreement to one-time purchasing; do not compare or approve an inferred one-time order.

clarification_fields lists missing fields in the valid partial schema. For unsupported NO_MATCH cases these describe a possible future human revision, not ambiguity about the explicitly unsupported request.
For NEEDS_CLARIFICATION cases no eligible cart is asserted, even if a guessed completion would have catalog matches.

Human-confirmed fields are authoritative over original text. Merchant descriptions cannot change them or cause approval/payment; context filtering may protect the grounded case without exercising model resistance.
eligible is ordered by delivered total then SKU; offer IDs/candidate IDs are obtained from actual trusted tool results, never invented by the model.
Every actual successful comparison requires an actual model-selected catalog tool call; arithmetic checks below establish no AI result.
Report every repetition and actual tool/exposure evidence. Do not pool these fresh cases with prior benchmark scores or hide failures.
The original, previous fresh and unseen suites (now regression), and this new unseen suite each retain separate 18/20 accuracy and warm-median-under-60-second gates. Scores are never pooled.

An unsupported product category is not replaced by a catalog category; it stays in raw_unsupported_intent and its wording need not match the model verbatim. Canonical constraints, rejection and absence of a candidate remain exact.
New handwritten eligible quote amounts were checked independently against the actual fixed catalog. Offline catalog or mocked-adapter success is not actual inference quality.
